evidence_required: identify the purpose of a short functional text
retrieve main explicit information from messages, notices, emails, and instructions
connect practical instructions without translating every word
identify gist in a short A2 narrative or description
retrieve explicit details across nearby sentences
connect time references and nearby information

mapping_note: The current Exercise Builder reading renderer stores each passage and its items as one versioned question. Each reading container in this pool therefore targets one outcome only. Standalone sequence tasks are independently versioned and mapped. Inner item skills are validated by the content-specific validator but cannot yet receive separate runtime outcome mappings.
